chapter_name: Chapter 09: Tenses: Present, Past, and Future
learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will grasp the concept of time in grammar and confidently form sentences in the Simple Present, Simple Past, and Simple Future tenses.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Let's go time traveling! ⏰ Verbs have a magical ability to change their shape to tell us exactly WHEN an action happened: yesterday, today, or tomorrow. We call this time travel 'Tenses'!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the Simple Present to talk about habits, daily routines, or facts that are always true. If the subject is singular (he/she/it), we usually add -s or -es to the verb.
examples_or_templates: Habit: I **brush** my teeth every morning.
Fact: The sun **rises** in the east.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The Simple Past is used for actions that are already finished. We usually add '-ed' to regular verbs. Irregular verbs completely change their spelling!
examples_or_templates: Regular (-ed): walked, talked, played (I **walked** to school yesterday.)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The Simple Future tells us about things that have not happened yet. It is the easiest tense because we just add the helping verbs 'will' or 'shall' before the main verb!
examples_or_templates: I **will visit** my grandma next week.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which sentence is in the Simple Past Tense?
❓ Fill in the correct verb: The earth _____ around the sun.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change this sentence to the Future Tense: 'We play cricket in the park.'
subjective_practice.hint: Add the magic word 'will' before the main action.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write the Simple Past form of these irregular verbs: Run, Write, Buy.
✍️ Write one sentence about something you do every day (Simple Present).

activity_or_assignment.title: 🕰️ The Time Machine Diary
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Divide a piece of paper into three columns: Yesterday, Today, and Tomorrow. Write 2 sentences in each column about your life, using the correct Past, Present, and Future verbs!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Tenses tell us the time of an action.
⭐ Simple Present is for habits and universal facts (Verb / Verb+s).
⭐ Simple Past is for completed actions (Verb+ed / Irregular change).
⭐ Simple Future is for actions yet to happen (will + Verb).
